question: Which of the following politicians was conferred a Lifetime Achievement Honour in 2023 by the India-UK Achievers Honours in London for contribution to economic and political life?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manmohan Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manmohan Singh** was conferred a Lifetime Achievement Honour in 2023 by the India-UK Achievers Honours in London.
 
• This recognition was for his significant contributions to the economic and political life of India.
 
• Manmohan Singh, a renowned economist, served as the Prime Minister of India from 2004 to 2014.
 
• Under his leadership, India witnessed substantial economic growth and development.
 
• He played a pivotal role in the liberalization of the Indian economy in the early 1990s.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manmohan Singh** has held various important positions, including Finance Minister of India and Governor of the Reserve Bank of India.
 
• He is widely respected for his contributions to economic policy and his role in transforming India's economic landscape.
 
• His tenure as Prime Minister is marked by initiatives aimed at promoting inclusive growth and socio-economic reforms.
 
• In addition to his political achievements, Manmohan Singh is also recognized for his academic contributions and has received numerous awards and honors globally.
